copy.tagline: 决定如何将已完成分支合并到主分支
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果开发完成需要决定分支合并策略
copy.tagline_en: Decide how to integrate a completed branch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide how to merge a finished development branch

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会引导你完成开发分支的收尾工作：先自动运行测试，然后根据你的 Git 环境（普通仓库、命名分支工作树或分离头指针）提供合并、创建 Pull Request 或保留分支等选项，并执行你选择的后续操作。
howto.when: 当你完成代码实现、所有测试通过，需要决定如何将分支工作集成到主分支时触发。

say.text: 帮我完成这个分支的收尾工作。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行测试并展示选项菜单。

say.text: 测试通过了，接下来怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会检测环境并给出合并、PR 或保留的选项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through finishing a development branch: it automatically runs tests, then presents options (merge, create PR, or keep) based on your Git environment, and executes your chosen action.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the branch work.

say_en.text: Help me finish this development branch.
say_en.note: Claude will run tests and show the options menu.
Claude will detect environment and present merge/PR/keep options.
